title: When a message can't be sent yet — round 2

steps.path: Send a message while a permission card is still waiting for you
steps.headline: One short sentence; Show card is now the dark button on the right, with Send anyway in its old style just left of it.
steps.changed: Your three answers from round 1: the shorter sentence, the button order reversed, and Show card filled in the theme's main colour.
steps.notice: The way forward is the button that stands out; Send anyway looks exactly as it always did.
steps.risk: In this green theme the dark button takes the theme's accent colour, so it is green rather than black.

steps.path: Send a message while a Claude Code pop-up is open in terminal view (here: /status)
steps.headline: The same sentence and order when the pop-up is only in the terminal: Send anyway, then a dark Open terminal.
steps.changed: Same changes as the card case. Captured again in the dev window with real Claude Code, after a real refused send.
steps.notice: Every refused send now reads the same; only the right-hand button changes with where the question is.
steps.risk: The sentence no longer says the question is in the terminal; the Open terminal button is the only hint.
